seabed.source: 2011 coastal LiDAR (DGT/APA via EMODnet HR, ~15 m) merged with the EMODnet DTM (~115 m), shifted to mean sea level
seabed.attribution: EMODnet Bathymetry; DGT and APA (2011 coastal LiDAR)

zone: each row from its break point to the shoreline

surf_heights.source: Ting & Kirby (1994), spilling breaker, inner surf zone
surf_heights.why: the model's broken waves stay about as tall as the water is deep; inside each breaking zone the height map and the moving wave are capped, not modelled
